text: 10 OVERDOSAGE While there is no experience with overdosage in human clinical trials, PAA, a toxic metabolite of glycerol phenylbutyrate, can accumulate in patients who receive an overdose [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . If over-exposure occurs, call your Poison Control Center at 1-800-222-1222 for current information on the management of poisoning or overdosage.
